system_name: Omega platform (silicon photonic) — utility-scale target Feb 2026
headline: PsiQuantum targets utility-scale delivery Feb 2026; Omega platform; $1B+ raised; Chicago site groundbreaking
details: PsiQuantum targets utility-scale quantum computer delivery by Feb 10, 2026. Omega platform: silicon nitride photonic chip integrating superconducting single photon detectors, sources, and optical switch. CEO transition: Victor Peng (Interim CEO), co-founder Jeremy O'Brien to Executive Chairman. Chicago site groundbreaking. Japan partnership with Tokyo/Mitsubishi Chemical for workforce training. Aiming for 1M qubits by 2027.
relevance_reason: Photonic architecture is fundamentally different from trapped-ion/neutral-atom and does not naturally run our MERA circuit design. Monitor for unexpected breakthroughs.
access_path: Not currently available for academic research circuits. Monitor commercial release timeline.
